evidence: Each card shows a module badge (API, UI Components, Data Layer, etc.). Clicking API filter reduced list to 5 API docs; clicking All restored all 19.
Selecting "REST API Design Guidelines" shows title, description, module badge API, date 2024-01-15, v2.3.0, 3 content sections and a Related Documents list of 4 docs.

Clicking "HTTP Methods Guide" link in collapsed "Endpoint Naming Conventions" section kept REST API doc open and showed toast "Please expand the section to access links"; after expanding, the same link opened HTTP Methods Guide.
Clicking the "HTTP Methods Guide" reference link in the expanded section switched the viewer to the HTTP Methods Guide document (h1 changed).

Collapsing "Method Semantics" hid its body text ("GET: Retrieve resources" gone) and turned its reference link into a disabled (cursor-not-allowed, opacity-60) placeholder; header remained clickable to reopen.
Re-expanding "Method Semantics" restored body text and made the "REST API Guidelines" link active (cursor:pointer, primary styling). Same behavior seen for "Endpoint Naming Conventions" earlier.

Section headers show a chevron-down icon with class "rotate-180" when expanded and without rotation when collapsed; state matched body/link visibility in every checked case (Method Semantics, Idempotency Requirements, Endpoint Naming Conventions).
Iterated all 19 documents and collected section reference chips + related-document lists; no document appeared in its own reference chips or related list.

Clicking JWT Authentication node added a pulse-glow selection ring to only that node. Zoom In 100%->120%, Zoom Out steps to 100/80/60% with matching % label and svg scale transform; Reset View returned to translate(0,0) scale(1) / 100%.

Graph has exactly 19 g.graph-node nodes matching the 19 documents; node stroke colors match the module legend (API cyan, Auth purple, Data green, UI amber, Core rose); 19 line edges equal the 19 unique related-document pairs derived from the documents.

All 19 documents from all 5 modules appear as nodes with 19 relationship edges; at 60% zoom the measured bounding box of all nodes (203-590 x, 77-466 y) lies fully inside the 1280x643 graph viewport, and Reset View restores the default fit.

issue: Graph node click does not open the document view; a manual tab change is required
actual: Single-clicking (and double-clicking) the "JWT Authentication" / "Session Management" nodes only added the selection glow. The active nav tab stayed "Knowledge Graph" (bg-primary on Knowledge Graph button) and no document content (no h1, title, sections, or related docs) was rendered anywhere in main — only the graph canvas, legend and zoom controls. The user must click the Documents tab manually to see the document.

evidence: Nav offers Documents, Knowledge Graph and Favorites buttons; clicking each activates it (bg-primary class) and renders its content (doc list/viewer, graph canvas, favorites list).

With Session Management selected (Session Storage expanded, Session Security collapsed) and graph zoom at 120%, switching Documents->Favorites->Graph->Documents kept the same selected document, identical per-section expand/collapse states, and graph transform "translate(0, 0) scale(1.2)" with 120% label; persisted store shows graphState {zoom:1.2,pan:{x:0,y:0}}. Pan stayed at 0,0 (drag panning produced no translate change), so pan preservation is trivially satisfied.

Search "zzzqqq" and the combination search "jwt" + UI module both showed "No documents found — Try adjusting your search or filter criteria"; clearing the search restored the 3 UI docs and clicking All restored all 19.

issue: Favorites view is filtered by the module filter chosen in Documents, hiding favorited documents from other modules
actual: Favorited JWT Authentication (Auth), Design Tokens (UI) and Rate Limiting (API): nav badge updated immediately (1→2→3), markers survived module filtering and Module/Title sorting, and favorites persisted after a page reload (badge still "3"). However, with the Documents module filter set to API, the Favorites view listed only "Rate Limiting" — JWT Authentication and Design Tokens were hidden even though the badge showed 3, and the Favorites view provides no module filter control to clear it (only search + sort). Selecting "All" back in Documents restored all 3 in Favorites. Behaviour also reproduced after reload (filter persisted).
